# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Feb 25, 2026)

## OVERVIEW
Today's development focused on implementing the L2ContractsManager for L2 predeploy upgrades, refactoring the op-devstack Orchestrator, and addressing various CI and supernode lifecycle management issues.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### L2 Contracts Manager Implementation
A significant feature addition was the implementation of the L2ContractsManager contract, which facilitates upgrades of L2 predeploys via `DELEGATECALL` from ProxyAdmin. This is a crucial step towards more flexible and robust L2 contract management. ([#19111](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19111))

### op-devstack Orchestrator Refactoring
The Orchestrator in `op-devstack` underwent a major refactoring, migrating from 15 separate registry fields to a single unified `*stack.Registry`. This streamlines the ID type system and improves the overall architecture of the development stack. ([#18875](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18875))

### CI and Supernode Enhancements
Several issues related to `contracts-bedrock` CI were fixed, improving the stability and reliability of the continuous integration pipeline. Additionally, work was done to eliminate duplicated lifecycle management and ensure proper application context closure in `op-supernode` and `op-devstack`, enhancing the robustness of supernode operations. ([#19300](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19300), [#19310](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19310), [#19306](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19306), [#19305](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19305))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- **Contract and Dependency Updates:** New pull requests include a fix for normalizing underscore prefixes in ABI parameter names for interface checks ([#19317](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19317)), a chore to bump `op-alloy` crates to version 0.24.0 ([#19314](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19314)), and a dependabot update to bump `github.com/cloudflare/circl` from 1.3.3 to 1.6.3 ([#19312](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19312)).
- **Supernode and Interop Fixes:** A fix for the supernode's initial block seal was opened ([#19308](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19308)), alongside an `op-interop-filter` fix addressing cross-validation performance, public admin endpoint, and reorg detection ([#19304](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19304)).
- **Derivation Pipeline Addition:** A new pull request introduces a pure derivation pipeline in `op-core/pure` ([#19303](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19303)).

## CLOSED ISSUES
- **RPC Performance Improvement:** An issue regarding RPC performance and preventing `eth_getLogs` memory exhaustion was closed ([#768](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/768)). The resolution notes that upstream Geth fixes will be pulled through in future updates, making specific OP Stack changes unnecessary.

## NEW ISSUES
- **L2CM Upgrade Path and Access Control:** Several new issues focus on L2 Contracts Manager (L2CM) upgrades, including adding an interop migration path to L2CM ([#19309](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19309)) and implementing `ProxyAdminOwnedBase` access control for predeploy `initialize()` functions ([#19313](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19313)).
- **L2CM Storage and Testing:** Further L2CM-related issues involve investigating automated enforcement to prevent storage variables in `L2ContractsManager` ([#19315](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19315)) and reusing `ProxyAdmin` tests on `L2ProxyAdmin` for backward compatibility ([#19316](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19316)).
- **Kona Node and Derivation Pipeline:** A new issue addresses conditionally deploying `CrossL2Inbox` in `kona-node` and `interop` ([#19311](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19311)).
- **Contract Refactoring and Bundle Canonicalization:** There's a new issue to refactor `OptimismMintableERC721Factory` to use the `Initializable` pattern ([#19318](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19318)) and to implement a Bundle Canonicalization process for L2CM upgrades ([#19307](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19307)).

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### L2CM Implementation and Upgrade Mechanism ([#18830](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18830))
Discussion continues on the implementation of the L2ContractsManager. A key point raised is the need for explicit checks for error swallowing patterns in the `L2ContractsManager` to ensure all individual upgrade calls revert on failure and propagate errors for atomicity (FMA follow-up FM6). Another FMA follow-up (FM2) emphasizes that `L2ContractsManager` must not declare storage variables to prevent corruption of `L2ProxyAdmin` storage during `DELEGATECALL` execution, a convention already followed by PR #19111.

### L2CM Upgrade Gas Mechanism ([#18832](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18832))
There are no new comments on this issue today.

### Deterministic JSON NUT Bundles ([#18834](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18834))
The discussion around generating deterministic JSON NUT bundles includes a suggestion to record the commit source for future validations. A new FMA follow-up (FM7) proposes a CI job for the NUT bundle generation script to regenerate and verify the bundle against the committed version on every PR, preventing tampered or incorrectly generated bundles.

### L2 Upgrade Fork Testing Infrastructure ([#18837](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18837))
An FMA follow-up (FM1) suggests that the fork testing infrastructure should include a test to verify the initialization state of all predeploys post-upgrade, ensuring they are properly initialized after the upgrade bundle executes.

### L2CM Acceptance Tests ([#18870](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18870))
An FMA follow-up (FM4) highlights that acceptance tests should verify the existence of the deterministic-deployment-proxy on all target L2 chains before the upgrade fork activates, as its absence would cause `ConditionalDeployer` to fail.

### op-supernode: Superroot SLA Updates ([#19180](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19180))
Recent comments indicate progress on a required database update to allow fetching of optimistic vs. verified outputs. There was also a note about skipping certain tests in a related PR due to missing partial `OptimisticAtTimestamp` data. The discussion also clarified that optimistic roots should be best-effort, including empty values if not obtainable.

### op-supernode: Prune Denylist on L1 Reorg and Alert ([#19289](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19289))
Discussion clarifies that the suggestion to enhance consistency during verification cycles and trigger the Supernode level `Reset(chain, ts)` callback for uncontrolled regressions of the Local Safe supersedes a previously linked ticket. It's also noted that Chain Containers may need to eliminate data from their Denylists if the Local Safe regresses due to an L1 reorg.

### op-proposer: sepolia devnet has timestamp as rootBlockNumber ([#19301](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19301))
It was clarified that the `sepolia-devnet-0` is no longer in use and is distinct from `op-sepolia`. The issue stems from an invalid proposer on the old devnet, and there's no need to fix it as the devnet is deprecated.

### miner: makeEnv historical state fallback is unreachable on full nodes using path-based state scheme ([#767](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/767))
A follow-up comment from `sentientpanic` seeks confirmation on whether the observed behavior is unintended and offers to submit a PR with a proposed fix. `ajsutton` questioned if this is an `op-geth` specific issue or if it applies to upstream Geth, suggesting a fix might be better implemented upstream.
